advisory_snapshot.provenance: Human-reviewed, minimal npm advisory snapshot for governed root overrides. The immutable SHA-256 above binds this record to the separately checked-in advisory content, so verify is deterministic and network-free; refresh both deliberately when an override or advisory changes.

scope.npm: All root package.json overrides are governed. Each must have a matching npm_overrides record with a rationale and a complete per-pin advisory_ids mapping. R2 deliberately fails closed for any live override: npm's lockfile records the override result, not a mechanically reproducible no-override resolution.
scope.cargo: The root candle-kernels patch remains HTTPS K9 at 182ceab0547348993b6dbec4b1aed610dcc8b23f (0.10.2). The embedder requires cudarc-fathomdb =0.20.0 and the coherent Candle fork trio =0.12.0. cargo_fork_pins binds each lock entry to the exact accepted local Git URL and revision, once per package and without a registry checksum. This is Slice110 local qualification only; no registry publication or registry-ready normalization is claimed. Owned external Cargo configuration supplies the four exact local overrides and the Candle file-source kernel override described in dev/plans/0.8.29/features/slice-110/design.md#exact-revision-local-consumption. Any other repository [patch], [replace], or direct Git dependency is unsupported, including libsqlite3-sys. Repository .cargo/config.toml and .cargo/config reject patch tables and unparseable candidates. The root K9 patch does not propagate through a published Rust crate.
scope.governed_commit_pins: scripts/governed-surface-pin.json pins repository contract content, not an external dependency version. Its commit/hash integrity is enforced by scripts/check-governed-surface-pin.sh; it has no package-advisory semantics and is explicitly not reinterpreted here.

cargo_candle_exception.rationale: The candle-kernels patch exists only to carry the Candle fork's statically linked CUDA runtime (fork items K4 and K6) into FathomDB-built artifacts, so CPU-mode distributable artifacts can map without libcuda.so.1 or libcudart while CUDA driver discovery stays dynamic (REQ-068, REQ31-16, owner ruling Q2). crates.io publishes candle-kernels 0.10.2 with dynamic libcudart; this immutable revision is the commit the Candle fork crates 0.11.0 were published from (182ceab0), whose candle-kernels tree equals the qualified 853324fc. The newer Candle fork trio uses the separate exact local Git source recorded in cargo_fork_pins; kernels retain this original HTTPS K9 source.

advisory_posture.scope: outside the checked-in npm advisory snapshot
advisory_posture.rationale: This is not a claim that the external Rust source has or lacks a vulnerability. The checked-in GitHub advisory snapshot covers only governed npm overrides; any revision change requires a fresh human advisory review.
